definitions.gloss: to call back; to summon back
definitions.explanation: To ask or order someone who has left to return.

definitions.gloss: to recall; to bring back (memories, feelings)
definitions.explanation: To cause something from the past to come back to mind or existence.

notes:
FORMATION:
A compound verb: ⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call) + ⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (to send back) — to call someone or something so that it comes back. In sense 2 the subject is typically an inanimate trigger (a photograph, a song, a scent) and the object is a memory or a feeling.

COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す — to call someone back
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す — to recall a memory
- ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す — to bring someone back to consciousness
- ⟦{本国|ほんごく}→本国：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す — to recall someone to their home country

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{呼|よ}び{出|だ}す→呼び出す：04813_yobidasu⟧ summons someone *to* the speaker — to an office, to the phone. {呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す returns them to where they were before.
- ⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧ is what you recover for yourself (health, confidence, a lead); {呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す works by calling out, whether to a person or, figuratively, to the past.
